mentions.description: A suite of the builder's own cloud-based, local-first apps optimized for e-ink tablets, specifically the Boox Palma 2, covering notes, book reader, browser, music player, maps, camera, etc., with a companion iOS app that combines all of them. The motivation is that when the author wants to disconnect, they can just grab the Palma and go.
mentions.problem: The author wants to disconnect from their phone while still having useful apps; existing apps are not optimized for e-ink tablets like the Boox Palma 2.
mentions.audience: Primarily the builder's own use — being able to disconnect by just grabbing the Palma and going; likely relevant to others who want local-first apps on e-ink devices.
mentions.author: yoz-y
